task_title: env_absent orders surfaced in validate output and audit table/json/md
task_criteria: Tier 1: uv run pytest -q passes with new tests, ruff check/format clean, check-test-count.sh PASS. Tier 2: (1) uv run python -m lore validate --class gateway-drain-window --execute plain-text output includes an env_absent: checks N,M line for any checks that classified as env-absent. (2) uv run python -m lore audit --format json includes an env_absent_orders field on any class whose history record carries env_absent orders. (3) uv run python -m lore audit --format table and --format md each render the env_absent column. (4) When env_absent_orders is empty, the field does not appear in JSON output.
